newsitem.title: UK: BFI up five as Atlantic Panamaxes remain firm.
newsitem.headline: BFI up five as Atlantic Panamaxes remain firm.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up five on Wednesday at 1,518 points and brokers said firm conditions continued for Panamax grain shipments in the Atlantic.

Cargill were understood to have booked Maratha Majesty 76,650 dwt for heavy grain Mississippi to Holland at a minumum of $14.50 and Seyang were understood to have fixed the NSAC relet Daphne for 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan for early January at $27.50 no combination (But many brokers believed the true market level is about $1 less).
ADM have fixed 88,000 grains Mississippi to Holland for early Janaury at a lumpsum equivalent of $13.00 basis 55ft.
Rates for Panamaxes in the Northern Pacific were said to be softening for the early positions but Caper rates remained steady.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was six points up to five points down and turnover was 304 lots.
